description: ADCOS Session object: a logical connectivity relationship independent of a particular radio bearer. Session identity must not encode a cell ID, bearer ID, radio technology, or vendor-specific modem identifier (spec/architecture.md §6.7; LOCK-006). Session lifecycle, renewal, replay-safety, and teardown are owned by WORK-012 and are deliberately not modeled here.

path_bindings.description: Path references currently bound to this logical session; multipath sessions bind multiple paths (architecture §5.4, §13).

session_id.description: Logical session identifier; access-independent and stable across supported handovers (LOCK-006, LOCK-021).

title: ADCOS Session
